novella.title: Hic Non Sunt Dracones
novella.tagline: A standalone historical adventure set in 1897, at the edge of a world that still believed there were blank spaces left on the map.
description: When Major Jason Havelock sets his sights on a lost city in the Brazilian wilderness, he pulls a reluctant young writer into an expedition shaped by obsession, fading empires, and the last great fantasies of exploration.
What begins as a romantic adventure turns quickly into something harsher: a journey toward a place shadowed by war, danger, and the collapse of an older way of seeing the world.
Hic Non Sunt Dracones is a complete standalone novella — part homage to the great adventure stories of the past, part farewell to them, and a first taste of the kind of fiction I write.
